Hijacking the PS5's RTMP Stream

Sony has progressively locked down what you can do with the PS5’s hardware. Streaming is a good example.

The Problem

I often stream games with friends on Discord, but the PS5 doesn’t support screen sharing to Discord.

DNS Trick

The PS5 doesn't hardcode Twitch's IP; it looks it up via DNS every time.

address=/contribute.live-video.net/192.168.8.175
address=/live.twitch.tv/192.168.8.175

If we control what DNS returns, we control where the stream goes.

  • dnsmasq
  • nginx-rtmp
